Equality requires every positive envelope entry to occur and be saturated. The last term is δ/2 and the predecessor supplies one further odd coefficient, yielding the exact suffix. Checked the finite example and screened 13,480 interior nodes of positive concave integer profiles with exact arithmetic, including 120 equalities. The odd profile has mean offset (N−1)(2N−1)/(6N), which cannot be integral because its numerator is one modulo N. A supporting line at an integral mean is therefore strict at some positive-mass index, proving strict Jensen.
